clean_description: In a world where a Dark Lord has triumphed, a young street urchin named Vin discovers her powerful abilities as a Mistborn, a rare type of magic user. She is drawn into a rebellion against the oppressive regime and must navigate complex political intrigue and personal loyalties. As she learns to harness her powers, she faces the realities of betrayal and the consequences of her actions in a struggle for freedom.
setting: a dystopian world ruled by a Dark Lord
